verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs list built-in deployment protection that controls access to preview and production URLs with passwords, alongside Vercel Authentication and trusted IPs. That delivers simple password gating without a custom auth system. The evidence is only a single one-line docs summary. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how password protection is configured and its scope or plan availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system

citations.quote: Control who can open your preview and production URLs with Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs.
